fields.review: Amazing game! The graphics are stunning and the gameplay is incredibly smooth. Spent hours playing and didn't even notice the time passing.
Pretty good overall. The story kept me engaged but I found some of the controls a bit clunky at times.
Absolute masterpiece! This is exactly what I was looking for. The attention to detail is incredible and the replay value is through the roof.
It's okay, nothing special. Some fun moments but overall felt pretty average. Might appeal to some people but wasn't for me.
Really enjoyed this one! Great balance between challenge and fun. A few minor bugs here and there but nothing game-breaking.
